title: Two pointers on a sorted array: every step rules one number out

steps.caption: Sorted input, find two numbers summing to 10. Start at both ends.
1 + 11 = 12 > 10. Even the smallest partner is too big for 11, so drop it: r -= 1.
1 + 8 = 9 < 10. Even the largest partner is too small for 1, so 1 can't be in the answer: l += 1.
3 + 8 = 11 > 10. Even the smallest partner is too big for 8, so drop it: r -= 1.
3 + 6 = 9 < 10. Even the largest partner is too small for 3, so 3 can't be in the answer: l += 1.
